context: Sho-young asks Asuka about a connective word; gentle grammar help.
purpose: Teacher patiently teaching connectives to a child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 先生、「そこで」って、どう使うの?
lines.en: Sensei, how do you use "so then"?
lines.style: curious child boy voice, soft warm engaged delivery carefully

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 困った時、次の行動を言う時に使うのよ。
lines.en: You use it to say the next action when stuck.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm gentle delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: soft child boy voice, warm engaged delivery carefully

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 何かを付け加える時。それから、こうも言えるわ。
lines.en: When adding something. And you can also say it like this.
lines.style: gentle teacher voice, soft warm explanatory delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 全く分からなかったけど、つまり、わかってきた!
lines.en: I had no clue, but — in short, I'm getting it!
lines.style: bright child boy voice, soft warm cheerful delivery carefully

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 例えば、お話を作って、練習しようね。
lines.en: Let's practice by making up a little story.
lines.style: tender teacher voice, soft warm patient delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: soft determined child boy voice, warm earnest delivery carefully
